title: Havannah Harbour Sunset Cruise & Dinner
description: Experience the ultimate tropical romance with a serene sunset cruise along the pristine waters of Havannah Harbour, followed by a beachside dinner under the stars.
<ul>
• 2-hour scenic cruise as the sun dips below the Pacific horizon.
• Complimentary sparkling wine or local Tusker beer upon boarding.
• Spot marine life in the calm, sheltered waters of the harbour.
• Gourmet 3-course dinner featuring fresh local seafood and organic island beef.

title: Mele Cascades Waterfall Tour
description: Escape to the lush, tropical rainforest of Vanuatu and witness the breathtaking beauty of the Mele Cascades. This guided tour takes you through spectacular jungle scenery, ending at the magnificent 35-meter waterfall.
Tour Highlights
<ul>
• Guided walk through vibrant tropical gardens & rainforests.
• Swim in the pristine, terraced natural pools cascading down the hillside.
• Refreshing stop at the main waterfall viewing platform.
• Relaxed tropical fruit platter served riverside.

title: Pele Island Beach Day
description:
Escape to paradise with our Pele Island Beach Day tour. Just a short boat ride from North Efate, Pele Island offers crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs perfect for snorkeling, and pristine white-sand beaches.

  • Return boat transfers included.
  • Guided snorkeling tour over protected coral reefs.
  • BBQ lunch served on the beach.
  • Free time to relax, swim, and explore the island village.

title: Port Vila City & Market Tour
description: Get your bearings and discover the vibrant heart of Vanuatu’s capital city. This comprehensive orientation tour takes you through the bustling local markets, historical landmarks, and scenic viewpoints of Port Vila.
<ul>
• Explore the colorful 24/7 Port Vila Market (Mama’s Market) for fresh organic produce and local handicrafts.
• Visit Parliament House and the National Museum of Vanuatu.
• Enjoy panoramic views of the harbor from the Port Vila lookout.
• Duty-free shopping stops available upon request.

title: Private Bus Hire
description: Flexible Group Transport: Hire a private bus and driver for 5 to 8 hours. You choose the stops; we provide the local expertise.
Ideal for Groups: Perfect for large families, wedding parties, or social groups who want to explore at their own pace.

title: Roots & Routes Cultural Tour | Kava Tasting | Port Vila, Custom Village Experience
description: A Journey into Tradition: Discover the "Custom" way of life on a 4-5 hour immersive cultural experience.
Authentic Cultural Highlights: Includes a guided Cultural Village Tour, a visit to the Cultural Centre, and an educational walk through endemic plants.

title: Dinner Transfer (Round Trip)
description: Enjoy a hassle-free evening out with our dedicated round-trip dinner transfer service. We will pick you up from your accommodation, take you to your chosen restaurant in Port Vila, and return you safely after your meal.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 12 hours before pickup.

title: Events Transfer Package: Professional Group Logistics
description:
Professional logistics and transport solutions for corporate events, weddings, and large group gatherings in Vanuatu. We offer a fleet of buses and coordinate schedules to ensure all your attendees arrive safely and on time.

  • Dedicated event transport coordinator.
  • Fleet of modern buses and VIP vans.
  • Customizable routes and schedules.

title: Havannah Harbour Resort Area Transfer
description: Premium long-distance transfer service covering the scenic drive from Port Vila to the exclusive North Efate resort region (The Havannah, Trees and Fishes, Gideon’s Landing).
Enjoy a comfortable, air-conditioned 45-minute drive featuring spectacular coastal views along the way. Bottled water included.

title: Hideaway Island Resort Transfer
description: Direct, comfortable shuttle service from Port Vila International Airport or your city hotel to the Mele Beach ferry point for Hideaway Island Resort.
Our air-conditioned vehicles ensure a relaxing start to your island getaway. We coordinate directly with the Hideaway Island ferry schedule so you never have to wait.

title: Hospitality Package
description:
Customized itineraries tailored to your schedule. Let us pick you up and drop you off for all your meetings.

  • Ideal for hosting out-of-town clients and business partners.
  • Starting at VT 25,000 - includes bus hire & driver (5-8 hours).
  • Special: VT 18,000 bus hire for NGOs for the whole day.

cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before. Non-refundable within 48 hours.

title: Wharf / Cruise Ship Transfer
description: Arriving by cruise ship? Maximize your time ashore with our prompt wharf pick-up service. We provide direct transportation from the cruise terminal to town or directly to your booked tours.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup.

title: ✈️ Premium Airport Transfer
description: Experience the ultimate in comfort and privacy with our VIP Premium Airport Transfer. Arrive in style in one of our luxury vehicles, featuring complimentary water, Wi-Fi, and a dedicated chauffeur.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup. 50% fee applies for late cancellations.

title: 15-Seater Minibus
description: Traveling with a large family group or wedding party? Our 15-seater Minibus offers reliable, spacious group transport so everyone can travel together.
<ul>
• Features: Manual/Automatic options dependent on availability, high-capacity dual Air Conditioning, spacious cabin.
• Seating: Up to 15 passengers. Large luggage trailer available upon request for airport runs.
• Note: Requires an appropriate heavy vehicle endorsement or can be hired with a dedicated local Ace Tours driver.

title: Toyota Prado SUV (7-Seater)
description: The ultimate family exploration vehicle. Experience Vanuatu’s rugged coastal roads in absolute comfort with the premium, air-conditioned Toyota Prado SUV.
<ul>
